Photo: ©Columbia Tristar/Courtesy Everett Collection PSKY+2.55% SONY+2.03%With the news of Chuck Norris’s passing at age 86, fans are remembering the martial-arts star for his roles in films like “The Delta Force” and ”Missing in Action,” as well as his long run on the CBS PSKY+2.55% TV series “Walker, Texas Ranger.”But Norris’s most enduring legacy — and perhaps the most lucrative — came much later, when he became one of the internet’s first viral icons.
